request: Recheck conversation core before final tests after repeated design changes; verify independent converted copy and unchanged original.
checks: Conversion calls native thread/start, never fork. It supplies no original thread ID, parent or lineage in creation parameters. Helper keeps the new native header and requires a distinct empty independent paginated target.

Source is opened read-only by copy/repair orchestration. Normal native unsubscribe may flush already pending metadata; after this close the fixed source witness is never rebound and all mutations target only the new thread.

Copy publication checks different file identity, source and target witnesses and both native writer locks, fsyncs a temporary and atomically replaces target only. Partial results remain unknown and cannot cause automatic replay.

Historical body event IDs are copied data, not a fork pointer, parent/session tree edge, hardlink or live source-history dependency. Live goal/queue databases, shell ownership and active child-agent state are not copied.

The actual CLI regression sends separately to both histories, confirms no prompt during conversion, deletes original, restarts runtime and still continues target without the later original-only message.

New native assertions add parentThreadId/forkedFromId null and separate path/inode/new identity/history_base checks without weakening prior assertions. Session-tree identity is additionally checked by independent retained-fixture evidence.

Normal send/resume rejects cross-provider changes; current-provider composer filtering is a view of the shared catalog, not a separate stale provider catalog. Unknown/partial aliases do not clear drafts prematurely.

Thread creation acknowledgements bridge native indexing lag. List requests include all providers. Accepted/unknown receipts plus lifecycle events refresh sidebar while directory ownership suppresses stale project results.

History traversal and snapshot ownership are keyed to thread, browser connection and runtime generation; switching threads cancels stale reads. Automatic resume is gated by continuation state and pending operations, not a new message.

Draft handoff preserves unsaved text and attachments and never copies or sends them implicitly. Conversion has two intentional steps, target-only successful handoff and durable operation receipt recovery.

CI defaults failures are corrected in fixtures only: script file avoids interpreting Codex -c as Node --check, and real provider identity is supplied to the same-provider model-selection test. Exact send settings and shutdown assertions remain.
limits: This is an additional source review and evidence review, not a new full-suite pass or a claim of mathematical absence of bugs.
Source byte immutability proof starts after normal native close/flush; original history/provider/name are not converted.
Independent conversations still share the selected project filesystem and external services. Conversion is not a worktree/filesystem snapshot or undo of earlier side effects.
Historical tool/child-agent IDs can remain visible in copied records; no new live agent tree is created from them. The retained fixture has no actual spawned child agent.
Opaque provider-encrypted compaction, inherited rollout history and unsupported compressed disk formats fail without conversion; supported public compacted replacement history is tested.
Final source-bound full matrix and deployment remain gated on CI repairs and the complete clean audit.
